gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.

gaps.explanation: 'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: A side-by-side ___ (COMPARE) of the two plans reveals clear differences.
gaps.explanation: 'A comparison of X and Y' — the noun form follows the article and adjective.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DIFFICULT) terrain slowed the rescue team.
gaps.explanation: 'Difficult terrain' — adjective needed; 'difficulty' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.
He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.
